name: Brazzaville
subtitle: Brazzaville, capital of the Republic of the Congo: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: About 2,138,236 people lived in the Commune of Brazzaville in the official May 2023 census (RGPH-5).

items.label: people in the Commune of Brazzaville, 2023

blocks.prompt: About how many people were counted in the Commune of Brazzaville in the 2023 census?

parts.text: 2,138,236 residents in the May 2023 RGPH-5 census conducted by the INS Congo, accounting for roughly 35% of the Republic of the Congo's entire population.

gaps: Full microdata analysis from the May 2023 census is still undergoing official publication.
First-hand local voices from sapeurs and Bacongo market vendors are still missing.
Some statements were removed on 15 November 2026 because the page cited for them did not contain the quoted words in an automatic check.
